Your 12 m spacing is a maximum: each run is divided into whole sections, and the fence lands at 9.3 m on centre.
A gate leaf hangs on two posts, but one of them is the line or terminal post already counted where the fence stops.
Pickets are counted at a 5.512 in pitch across the net length, rounded up; the last board is ripped rather than pretended to fit.
Concrete per hole is the cylinder less the post: 10 in across x 24 in deep, minus a 3.5 in post, at 0.45 cu ft a bag.
The hole depth is the one you dig to. How deep a post must be set, the frost line, any required spacing, height limit or setback are your local code and are not printed here.
